snippet.description:
ÚLTIMA HORA | EEUU evacua de urgencia aviones militares de Reino Unido ante una amenaza de Irán

Según fuentes del Pentágono citadas por The Wall Street Journal, el ejército estadounidense ha iniciado una evacuación de emergencia de aviones cisterna de reabastecimiento en vuelo desde la base británica de RAF Mildenhall con destino a Alemania y otros emplazamientos seguros. Paralelamente, las bases estratégicas de RAF Mildenhall y RAF Lakenheath han elevado sus protocolos de seguridad a nivel FPCON Charlie, reservado para situaciones de riesgo terrorista y ataque militar probable. La tensión se dispara tras el anuncio oficial de Teherán de eliminar el límite autoimpuesto de 2.000 kilómetros para el alcance de sus misiles, poniendo a las bases occidentales en Europa dentro de su rango operativo. snippet.title: AMD快倒了才找她，八年後市值超越英特爾｜黃仁勳的表外甥女「蘇媽」蘇姿丰
snippet.description:
2014年10月，AMD 找她當執行長的時候，一股只剩兩塊多美元，欠的債22億美元，手上的現金10億美元。八年後，AMD 的市值第一次超過英特爾。

半導體這一行，大家記得的英雄都是創辦人：張忠謀五十五歲創台積電，黃仁勳三十歲在丹尼斯餐廳創輝達。蘇姿丰不一樣，公司不是她的，她是被請來救火的。1969年她生在台南民族路，三歲前是阿嬤帶大的，看的是史艷文；搬到紐約皇后區以後，弟弟的遙控車不動了，她把螺絲轉開，找到一條鬆掉的線。媽媽英文不好，一個人把汽車零件生意做到好幾百萬美元。她中文字拿C，茱莉亞音樂學院沒考上，進了麻省理工；在 IBM 學到「東西沒出貨，就不算完」；在飛思卡爾第一年業績差了一半，老闆罵她太差，她說他是對的。2014年全世界都在搶做手機，連董事會都問她為什麼不做，她算過以後說不，把公司押在大電腦和資料中心上。論輩分，黃仁勳是她的表舅（媽媽的表兄弟）。同一年，他也帶著輝達退出了手機。

黃仁勳的故事：https://youtu.be/s20jdfJuAVU

Lisa Su took over a nearly bankrupt AMD in October 2014 at about $2 a share; in February 2022 its market value passed Intel's. Her relative Jensen Huang is her mother's cousin.

Saudi Arabia has successfully intercepted fresh missile attacks attributed to Yemen's Houthi forces. According to reports, a ballistic missile and a cruise missile fired towards the Saudi capital, Riyadh, were destroyed by air defense forces. Coalition forces also intercepted another ballistic missile over the southern region of the Kingdom. Following the successful interceptions, security alerts issued for the Saudi cities of Abha and Khamis Mushait were withdrawn. The latest developments come amid continued regional tensions and renewed concerns over security in Saudi Arabia.


Meanwhile, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned that Tehran would not remain silent if the United States launches another attack. He demanded that Washington accept Iran's conditions, including an end to the war on all fronts. Iran's military spokesperson also vowed an immediate response to any aggression. Meanwhile, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed that 11 oil tankers had been targeted in the Strait of Hormuz over the past 10 days and claimed oil shipments through the strategic waterway had been halted.



Explosions were reported in Iran's coastal areas, including Qeshm, Bandar Abbas, Sirik and Jask, amid heightened military activity in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Iranian official Mohsen Rezaei has issued a strong warning to the United States, mocking President Donald Trump over the war and elections. He also claimed that US officials are facing growing pressure. In another significant development, the IRGC spokesperson indicated that Iran could reconsider its nuclear doctrine if the country's leadership decides.


What are Iran's seven conditions? Will tensions between Washington and Tehran escalate further? Watch the latest developments and updates on SAMAA.

snippet.title: 'Answer!' Testigo tameme, Chiz naubos ang pasensya, Raffy napikon | ABS-CBN News
snippet.description:
Sa ika-41 araw ng impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte nitong Martes (Nobyembre 10), sumalang bilang testigo ng depensa si Davao City Accountant Vingelin Bajan, kaugnay ng umano'y unexplained wealth ng bise.

Sa isang bahagi ng pagdinig, tinawag na "maang-maangan" ni senator-judge Raffy Tulfo si Bajan dahil sa hindi nito pagsagot sa mga tanong ng prosekusyon at ni presiding officer Sen. Chiz Escudero.

Dagdag pa ni Tulfo, baka raw dapat nang "patikman ma-contempt" ang mga testigong tulad ni Bajan.

"My patience is wearing thin," sabi naman ni Escudero.

4. 뚜껑을 열고 약불에서 3분 정도 살살 볶아 남은 물기를 날립니다.
5. 들기름 3큰술은 이때 넣고 2분만 가볍게 볶아 향을 입힙니다.
6. 불을 끄면 바로 넓은 접시에 펼쳐 한 김 식힙니다. 팬에 그대로 두면 남은 열에 물러집니다.

소금을 볶을 때 뿌리면 간이 겉에만 붙고 무가 쉽게 부서집니다. 미리 절이면 무가 낭창해져서 잘 꺾이지 않고 간이 속까지 뱁니다. 따로 물을 붓지 말고 무에서 나온 물로 익혀야 무의 단맛이 진하게 남습니다. 제사상용이면 마늘과 파는 빼셔도 됩니다. 무나물 비빔밥으로 먹어도 맛있습니다.

snippet.title: Cornyn on Talarico: "I wish him well"
snippet.description:
Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX) said Monday he wished his successor, Sen.-elect James Talarico (D-TX), well and considered it his responsibility to help him transition into the Senate despite their political differences. The two met ahead of freshman orientation for newly elected senators.
 
"I consider it my responsibility to help him in his transition as the next senator from Texas," he said. "I wish him well. Obviously, his politics are different from mine."
 
Sen. Cornyn lost the Republican primary to Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, who went on to lose the general election to Mr. Talarico.
 
Sen. Cornyn also addressed what he described as divisions within the Democratic Party, saying Democrats will have to "deal with problems in their own party."
 
"They've got the Democratic Socialists of America who want to dictate the direction of the Democratic Party, which is clearly not in sync with where Americans are," he said. "The non-DSA Democrats are going to have a challenge trying to keep everybody on the same page."

snippet.title: How a Mountain Becomes a Secret Base 😳 #military #norad #cheyennemountain #bunker #animation #shorts
snippet.description:
It starts as a cave dug into a mountain to hide from bombers. Then every threat gets its own answer: a tunnel dug all the way through so the blast flies out the other side, a base built off to the side behind two 25-ton steel doors, every building set on giant springs so the shaking mountain can’t break it, about 600 meters of granite overhead, giant filters for poisoned air, underground water reservoirs and its own power plant so the crew can stay locked in for weeks.

That is Cheyenne Mountain in Colorado, the NORAD bunker built inside a granite mountain of the Rocky Mountains’ Front Range.

Sources:

Cheyenne Mountain Complex (Wikipedia): https://www.wikipedia.org/wiki/NORAD_Computer_System
Air & Space Forces Magazine, July 2016: https://www.airandspaceforces.com/PDF/MagazineArchive/Documents/2016/July%202016/0716mountain.pdf
Military Wiki, Cheyenne Mountain Complex: https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Cheyenne_Mountain_Complex
Fox News, rare look inside Cheyenne Mountain: https://www.foxnews.com/us/rare-look-inside-cheyenne-mountain-complex-americas-fortress
USA Today, June 2015: https://www.pressreader.com/usa/usa-today-international-edition/20150615/281479275042852

Simplified for the animation: sizes, layout, the number of buildings and the order of the steps are illustrative (the real base was built in the 1960s in one project, not step by step). The bear is a joke. The doors are quoted at 23 to 25 tons depending on the source.

All 3D made in Blender.

snippet.title: When Woody Harrelson Tried To Rewrite No Country For Old Men 🎬😂
snippet.description:

snippet.description:
Reyna Haydee Ramírez confrontó a Claudia Sheinbaum durante la mañanera por el caso de Guadalupe Taddei y reprodujo un audio con declaraciones de Andrés Manuel López Obrador sobre su nombramiento.

Durante el intercambio, Sheinbaum también reconoció que en su momento existió una valoración positiva sobre Taddei, pero sostuvo que cualquier posible irregularidad debe investigarse independientemente de la filiación política.
